name: Fill All Fields on Company General Page
description:
Auto-fill every field on the General tab with random data.

        Steps:
        1. Iterate through all sections on the General tab
        2. For each section, auto-fill every input field
        3. Handle special cases (Declarations: check all, Trading Address: select 'No')
        4. Submit the application
        5. Verify no validation errors remain

        Expected Results:
        • All fields are filled with random values
        • No sections are marked as invalid after submission
